verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenHands has Git integrations and GitHub-connected automations that act on repositories, such as opening fix PRs, reviewing PRs and triaging reviewers. Nothing describes how repository access is granted, or that it is a one-click install with no complex setup. missing for 10: documented one-click install or app authorization flow for repository access, evidence of a low-setup onboarding experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.
